title: App icon design for ultra-premium mindfulness dating sanctuary app 'UR-Heart'. Squircle app icon container with subtly rounded corners (Apple iOS and Android adaptive icon style). Masterpiece 3D tactile craftsmanship: Rich deep dark pine emerald and obsidian background (#0A1311 to #030807) with luxurious velvet depth and fine micro-texture. At the center, an iconic, graceful, flowing calligraphic heart silhouette rendered in radiant liquid rose-gold and warm terracotta copper glass enamel, gently floating with a luminous inner caustic glow and soft ambient flare. Subtle organic botanical leaf aura contour seamlessly intertwined with the heart loop, representing natural intentional intimacy, unhurried resonance, and cryptography-grade privacy. Rim lighting with delicate metallic chamfered border edges, subtle refraction, ultra-refined, clean minimalist vector-like icon clarity that works at 1024x1024 as well as small phone home screen sizes. No text, no letters, no clutter, pure iconic emblem.
